subject: [PATCH 01/12] mm/khugepaged: drop redundant mm_struct pin in madvise_collapse()

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the khugepaged functionality by dropping redundant mm_struct pins in various functions, including madvise_collapse(). The optimization is achieved by removing unnecessary mmgrab() and mmdrop() pairs, which are already covered by existing mm_users references. This change improves memory management efficiency and reduces potential issues related to premature folio refcount drops.
